_original_lore: Lost but never forgotten. This was
Einary's favorite hoodie. Slip it on
and maybe you'll feel the love and
courage he left behind. Don't tell him
name: Einary的红色连帽衫

source: Lost but never forgotten. This was
Einary's favorite hoodie. Slip it on
and maybe you'll feel the love and
courage he left behind. Don't tell him
loreParagraphs.translation: 虽已失去,却从未被遗忘.这是 Einary 最喜欢的连帽衫.穿上它,或许能感受到他留下的爱与勇气.别告诉他你穿过它!
